base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI destination icon for Portal Roulette, a World of Warcraft mage travel wheel. Generate ONE square full-bleed painted city scene. Rich hand-painted Warcraft-inspired fantasy illustration, crisp broad silhouettes, luminous focal landmark, atmospheric but uncluttered, readable at just 64 pixels. Center the identifying landmark within the central 70% so a circular UI crop preserves it; keep background filling every corner. Close monumental composition, low detail density, strong light-dark separation, subtle painterly texture. No text, letters, symbols, logo, watermark, badge, medallion, circular outline, metallic border, outer frame, UI, or collage. The application supplies the circular mask and glass rim. Full opaque square artwork, not a cutout. Subject:

subjects.stormwind: Stormwind: majestic pale limestone human cathedral with a tall central blue-and-gold roofed spire and two lower blue roofed towers, sunlit white stone against a rich clear azure sky, hints of green trees at the base. Blue and ivory with restrained gold. The recognizable building fills most of the center.
subjects.ironforge: Ironforge: massive dwarven stone entrance carved into a mountain, a broad angular arch and heavy dwarven masonry, brilliant amber-orange forge glow within the central gate, iron and bronze details, snowy blue-grey crags around the sides. Monumental squat silhouette, warm molten center against cool stone.
subjects.darnassus: Darnassus: an enormous ancient violet-leaved world tree framing an elegant night-elven temple and luminous turquoise pool. Pale curved elven stone, lavender canopy, a bright moonlike light behind the central branches. Strong arching tree silhouette, tranquil emerald and violet palette, clearly fantasy elven city.
subjects.orgrimmar: Classic Orgrimmar: massive red-brown timber and stone orc gateway with two chunky timber watchtowers, big ivory tusk spikes, red cloth roof accents, warm Durotar canyon behind it. Ochre, deep red, weathered wood. Strong broad gate silhouette. Classic tribal architecture, no later-era black iron industrial fortress.
subjects.undercity: Undercity: ruined gothic Lordaeron stone gateway with a pair of broken towers and a central pointed arch opening into eerie emerald-green underground light. Cold charcoal stone, muted plague-green glow and blue-grey fog. Strong recognizable ruined castle silhouette, luminous green focal opening. No skull badge.
subjects.thunder_bluff: Thunder Bluff: tall central tauren totem and hide-roofed lodge atop a grassy red-rock mesa, a hanging rope bridge leading inward, golden plains and open turquoise sky behind. Bold carved totem silhouette, sunlit ochre, turquoise and warm cream. Tribal fantasy architecture, clear elevated mesa identity.
subjects.dalaran: Dalaran: elegant violet and rose-colored mage city towers, three central slender spires with conical purple roofs and warmly lit arched windows, soft amethyst magical sky, faint arcane glow between the towers. Tall central mage spire dominates. Lavender, deep violet, touches of gold and cyan. Magical city scene, no eye emblem or spell-book.
subjects.karazhan: Karazhan: a single unmistakable tall crooked gothic wizard tower with stacked stone sections and peaked purple roof, two small subordinate turrets, warm violet-lit windows, dark Deadwind Pass trees and jagged rock silhouettes. Tower looms against a luminous violet moonlit sky. Deep indigo, amethyst and restrained cyan; ominous but legible.

notes: Sources are retained PNGs; exported textures are 256x256 uncompressed RGBA TGAs. Runtime applies the existing circle mask and glass/hover lighting. Original emblem assets remain available in Alliance and Horde subfolders.
